changes.reason: Waiting for the exclusive writer slot now observes request cancellation. The same one-writer and SQLite stage/commit/rollback semantics remain; no rejected write gains a new commit path.

models.limits: Abstract admitted/refused mutations and commit visibility only. Waiting, scheduling, cancellation latency, the Go channel/driver, transaction effects after a lost acknowledgement, and HTTP/SDK behavior are not modeled. The queued refusal and concurrent unrelated commit are separately exercised against SQLite.

changes.reason: Deterministic concurrency regression against the actual SQLite Store. Does not change production state or the model.
